reason: Owner-authorized production release for the Pack One Admin dashboard gateway fix merged in PR #1358 (main commit cf7434544499f2222114d1409015cd70ed4796d0). All PR CI checks, including gateway runtime and browser tests, passed. Deploy the exact merged revision using the existing protected development-to-production release workflow. Require Admin gateway/backend/browser contract checks and new production unauthenticated 401-not-404 smoke for all four endpoints. No new authorization, data mutations, migrations, model/scoring, corpus, serving-policy, reminders, subscription, secret rotation, or mobile/app-store changes; preserve existing protected approvals and monitoring.
